children.title: Prior / tractable plots draw directly (no sampler backend). Use the gear to set the forward draw count + seed.
Sampler settings
Re-run the sampler with the current settings (re-draw)

Constrained-draw region for nested sampling. region-free (default) is the most reliable for the evidence logZ; whitened = global MLFriends ellipsoid; RadFriends = raw-cube-metric balls; cluster = per-cluster local ellipsoids — fastest sampling, but trades away logZ accuracy (use for exploration, not evidence).
Total draw count in the empirical measure (1,000)
Download draws (gzipped CSV or JSON)
